assets.processing: Uniform resize to 768×512 and WebP encoding at quality 90; generated alpha preserved; no object repainting
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a transparent raster illustration used as a quiet decorative background at the edge of a Korean medicine doctor's personal profile website. Create one elegant casual medical still-life motif, not a UI and not an icon button. Style: refined hand-painted watercolor and fine colored-pencil outlines, softly dimensional little objects, light paper-like surfaces, delicate warm antique Korean medicine tool details inspired by RPG medical skill motifs. A restrained coherent family of cream #f6f0e4, sage green #617d68, pale warm gold, and small muted gray metal highlights. Genuinely transparent alpha background. Objects grouped loosely with generous transparent negative space, about 70% frame occupied; no entire paper/card background. No text, words, numbers, labels, people, hands, bodies, faces, patients, logos, border, frame, medical cross, neon glow, watermark, or opaque backdrop. Objects fully in frame, clean silhouette; preserve readable object forms even at small web scale. Light gentle mood; no blood or invasive treatment scene.
Subject: a small traditional acupuncture needle case lying diagonally with precisely three slender silver acupuncture needles with subtly golden coiled handles, one or two soft mugwort sprigs and a folded cream linen cloth. Carefully separated needles so their fine metal shafts are recognizable. Elegant sparse diagonal still life, near top-down three-quarter view.
